learnings.title: GitHub changelog feed: Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models in December
learnings.claim: GitHub changelog feed fetched 2026-11-14 lists as newest item: "Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models in December" (Fri, 13 Nov 2026 20:40:05 +0000). Not independently verified.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: The 'system' plan should inventory current project usage of GitHub Copilot models and schedule timely migrations to supported alternative models before the December deprecation takes effect.
learnings.next_measurement: Reviewer opens the item link and confirms relevance before promotion.
